title: Established Member Share on a Prescription Insurance on File Cash Fill Re-Bill
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, an established member earns a member share on a re-billed cash fill, counted on the **net paid claims** of the coverage: its paid claims less its reversals, as the coverage's claim ledger shows them.

## Rule

| Net paid claims on the coverage | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.8 |
| One to fewer than 3 | 0.9 |
| None | 1 |

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent is made once, at the end.

## Counting (hypothetical claim ledgers)

| Paid claims on the coverage | Reversals on the coverage | Net paid claims | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1 | 4 | 0.8 |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 0.8 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 0.9 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 0.9 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |

Every paid claim on the coverage is counted, whatever its basis, and every reversal on the coverage is subtracted.
